newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen wandering lower on U.S. holiday.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen wandering lower on U.S. holiday.

text.p: Chilean stocks were likely to drift lower Monday amid profit-taking after last week's rally, on thin volume sapped by the U.S. holiday, traders said.

Prime candidates for profit-taking were electricity stocks, which have soared after heavy rains eased fears of drought hitting hydroelectric energy generation. Traders said another likely target was steel company Compania de Acero del Pacifico, or CAP, which lead gains among infrastructure stocks to close up 2.8 percent Friday.

The rain helped the Santiago bourse close Friday at its highest level since 1994. The IPSA index of the 40 most-traded shares ended at 125.22 points, up 1.24 percent, and the general IGPA index ended 0.82 percent higher at 5491.97 points on trading of shares worth 36.6 billion pesos, the highest volume of the year.
